jobs.name: bot2_avatar_wordmark
jobs.prompt: Square avatar for the Telegram bot of «ИИАВАТАР» — an AI video studio (text turns into video with a digital presenter). Match the attached website hero image: near-black graphite background #111311 with a subtle warm orange glow, one signal orange accent #F3531B, off-white #F9F9F6. Strictly centred, everything inside the central 65% (cropped to a circle). A bold monogram «ИИ» (two Cyrillic letters И, perfectly spelled, extra-bold geometric grotesque like Sora ExtraBold, off-white) with a solid orange #F3531B play-triangle integrated into the right letter. Flat vector, crisp, premium, high contrast, readable at 64 px. No other text, no frame, no mockup.
jobs.meaning: аватарка бота ИИАВАТАР: монограмма «ИИ» с оранжевым треугольником play на графитовом фоне с тёплым свечением, по центру, в стиле сайта (графит + оранжевый)

jobs.name: bot2_welcome
jobs.prompt: Wide welcome banner (16:9, will be shown at 640x360) for the Telegram bot that delivers client requests from the website of «ИИАВАТАР» — an AI video studio that turns text into video with a digital presenter. Match the attached website hero image exactly in mood and palette: dark graphite studio #111311, warm orange studio lamp glow, signal orange #F3531B accent, off-white #F9F9F6. Composition: on the LEFT half big extra-bold uppercase Russian typography (Sora ExtraBold style), two lines «ЗАЯВКИ» in off-white and «С САЙТА» in orange #F3531B, above them a small off-white wordmark «ИИАВАТАР». On the RIGHT half a photorealistic dark desk scene like the reference: a monitor showing a friendly woman presenter in a dark blazer, and a smartphone in the foreground showing a chat with an orange notification badge. Keep a safe margin from all edges. Perfect Russian spelling; no other text, no logos, no watermarks, no UI gibberish on screens.
jobs.meaning: приветственная картинка бота: слева «ИИАВАТАР» мелко, крупно «ЗАЯВКИ» белым и «С САЙТА» оранжевым; справа тёмная студия с монитором с ведущей и телефоном с уведомлением; стиль сайта (графит + оранжевый)
